title: Expression, purification, and characterization of a membrane-associated cyclic oligo-adenylate degrader from Sulfolobus islandicus
protocol: Amplify the gene encoding the membrane-associated DHH-DHHA1 family protein (SiRe_0244) by PCR using genomic DNA of S. islandicus as template.
Purify the PCR product with HiPure PCR Pure Mini Kit following the manufacturer's instructions.
Digest the purified PCR product and vector pSeSD with NdeI and SalI in a reaction mixture at 37°C for 2 hours.
Purify the digested DNA fragments using a HiPure PCR Pure Mini Kit.
Ligate the purified DNA fragments using T4 DNA Ligase in a reaction mixture at 22°C for 2 hours.
Transform the ligated plasmid into E. coli DH5α cells via classical heat shock transformation procedure.
Plate transformed cells onto LB-agar plates containing 100 μg/mL ampicillin.
Pipette up a colony using a 1 mL tip and scatter the colony in 50 μL H2O by pipetting up and down.
Use 1 μL of the cell suspension as template for PCR amplification with 2XTaq Master Mix.
Transfer the residual cell suspension into 1 mL LB medium containing 100 μg/mL ampicillin and culture at 37°C for 6 hours with shaking.
Run agarose gel electrophoresis to analyze the PCR products.
Transfer 0.5 mL of a validated cell suspension into a new EP tube and send the sample for Sanger sequencing.
Transfer the left cell suspension into 5 mL LB medium containing 100 μg/mL ampicillin and grow cells at 37°C for 16 hours with shaking.
Extract the plasmid from grown cells using HiPure Plasmid Micro Kit.
Thaw a tube of competent cells and mix them with ~500 ng of pSeSD-SiRe_0244.
Transfer the mixture into an 1 mm electroporation cuvette.
Place the cuvette in the cuvetter chamber of Gene Pulser Xcell Electroporation System (Bio-Rad, USA) and apply electrical pulse at 1.2 kV, 25 μF, 600 Ω.
Resuspend the cells with 1 mL of pre-warmed incubation medium immediately after electrical pulse.
Transfer the cell suspension into an EP tube.
Incubate the cells at 75°C for ~1 h without shaking.
Pre-warm solutions required for plating in 15 mL tubes, including 4 mL of 0.4% gelrite and 4 mL of 2× SCV for each plate.
Pipette 1 μL and 10 μL of the cell suspension into tubes containing 2× SCV respectively.
Pour 4 mL of 0.4% gelrite into each tube, mix them quickly, and pour the mixture onto a SCV plate.
Mix competent cells without any vector.
Mix empty vector (pSeSD) with competent cells.
Place the plates in a plastic box.
Place the plastic box containing the plates in a 75°C incubator.
Maintain moisture inside the plastic box to prevent drying of the plates.
Check the plates after seven days for colony growth.
Transfer 6–8 colonies onto new plates if colonies are present.
Transfer about 30 μL H2O in an EP tube.
Pipette up a colony from the plate using a 1 mL tip and scatter the colony in the 30 μL H2O by pipetting up and down.
Transfer the cell suspension onto a new SCV plate.
Verify the cultures using PCR after 2–3 days of growth: Transfer 300 μL culture into an EP tube.
Centrifuge at 8,500 × g for 3 min to collect the cells.
Resuspend the cells with 500 μL H2O and heat the cell suspension at 95°C for 10 min.
Cool the cell solution on ice and use 1 μL as template for PCR analysis.
Prepare cell mass for protein purification: Transfer a verified culture into 30 mL STV medium.
Inoculate the strain into 100 mL STV medium after 1 or 2 days when OD600 is about 0.6–0.8.
Transfer the 100 mL culture into 1 L STV medium after another day when OD600 is about 0.6–0.8.
Thaw the frozen cells in warm water.
Disrupt the cells by JN-02C French press with the pressure of 1,200 bar.
Supplement DDM into the cell lysate at a final concentration of 0.1%.
Incubate the lysate at 4°C for 16 hours with gentle shaking.
Centrifuge at 18,000 × g for 20 minutes at 4°C to remove undisrupted cells or cell debris.
Filter cleared lysate with 0.22 μm syringe filter.
Load filtered lysate onto the column at a speed of about 1 mL/min using Peristaltic Pump P-1.
Equilibrate Superdex 200 Increase 10/300 GL column with filtered water and then BufferC1 at a speed of about 0.5 mL/min until UV, pressure, and conductivity values are stable.
Wash pumps A and B with BufferA1 and BufferB1 respectively.
Equilibrate the ÄKTA system with BufferA1.
Remove the HisTrap column from Peristaltic Pump P-1 and connect it with the ÄKTA system.
Wash the column with 100% BufferA1 (20 mM imidazole) for 50 mL.
Continue washing with 91% BufferA1 and 9% BufferB1 (63.2 mM imidazole) for 30 mL.
Elute bound proteins with 41% BufferA1 and 59% Buffer B1 (~300 mM imidazole) for 20 mL.
Wash the column with 5 mL of 100% BufferB1.
Collect fractions corresponding to the main peak.
Concentrate collected fractions to approximately 0.5 mL.
Centrifuge concentrated sample at 18,000 × g for 20 min at 4°C to remove protein aggregates.
Remove the HisTrap column from the ÄKTA system.
Equilibrate the ÄKTA system with BufferC1 again.
Wash the injection loop with filtered water.
Wash the injection loop with BufferC1.
Connect the Superdex 200 column to the ÄKTA system.
Load concentrated proteins into the injection loop using a 1 mL syringe.
Set the methods as shown for SEC: flow rate at 0.5 mL/min, injection valve set to inject, alarm pre-column pressure at 2.20 MPa, fraction volume at 1 mL, auto zero UV.
Start running the size exclusion chromatography (SEC).
Wash the columns with filtered water after running methods.
Fill the columns with 20% ethanol.
Wash the HisTrap column with 10 mL of stripping buffer (20 mM sodium phosphate, 0.5 M NaCl, 50 mM EDTA, pH 7.4) to strip off Ni²⁺ ions.
Wash the column with 10 mL of distilled water.
Remove ionically bound proteins by washing with 10 mL of 1.5 M NaCl.
Wash the column with 10 mL of BufferA1.
Continue washing with an additional 10 mL of distilled water.
Eliminate precipitated protein using 60 mL of 1 M NaOH.
Follow up with another wash cycle using 10 mL of BufferA1 and 10 mL of distilled water.
Remove lipids and lipoproteins by washing the column with 10 mL of 0.5% Triton X-100 in 0.1 M acetic acid.
Final rinse with 10 mL of distilled water.
Charge the column with 1 mL of 0.1 M NiSO₄.
Wash again using 10 mL of distilled water.
Fill the column with 20% ethanol.
Perform washing steps at a flow rate of 1 mL/min using a Peristaltic Pump P-1.
Cast SDS-PAGE gels using Mini-PROTEAN Tetra Handcast System (Bio-Rad, USA).
Mix 20 μL of each fraction with 5 μL of 5× SDS-loading dye.
Heat the mixture at 95°C for 5 min.
Set up the Mini-PROTEAN Tetra Vertical Electrophoresis Cell (Bio-Rad, USA) for running the gel.
Fill the tank with SDS-PAGE running buffer.
Load samples into the wells and start running.
Prepare a denaturing polyacrylamide gel.
Mix 1.5 mL of 10× TBE, 18 mL of 30% acrylamide and 12.6 g urea in a 50 mL tube.
Invert the tube several times and place it in a 37°C incubator to accelerate dissolution of urea.
Set up two glasses to gain space for the gel using BG-verMIDI vertical electrophoresis system (Baijing, China).
After urea is dissolved, add 150 μL APS and 10 μL TEMED into the mixture.
Mix them quickly and pour the mixture into the space between the two glasses.
Insert comb immediately.
After the acrylamide is polymerized, remove the comb.
Wash the wells with 0.5× TBE.
Pre-run the gel in a PAGE tank at a voltage of 200 V for 30 min.
Mix the reaction components as shown and divide into 12 aliquots.
Add 1 μL of each fraction from gel filtration chromatography to the aliquots.
Incubate the reactions at 70°C for 4 min.
Chill the tubes on ice immediately.
Add 10 μL of 2× RNA loading dye.
Heat the samples at 95°C for 5 min.
Chill the samples on ice for 2 min immediately.
Centrifuge for several seconds to collect the liquid at the bottom of the tube.
Wash the wells with 0.5× TBE again.
Load the samples into the well.
Run the gel at a voltage of 300 V.
When the bromophenol band reaches the middle of the gel, stop running.
Remove the small glass from the gel.
Adhere the gel to an equal-size filter paper.
Cover the gel with cling film.
Place the gel in a cassette and cover with Storage Phosphor Screen BAS-IP MS 2025 E (Cytiva, USA).
Place the cassette in a freezer for 16 h.
Scan the screen with Fujifilm FLA-5100 (FUJIFILM Life Science, Japan) to obtain the image.
Open the image from step 39 by ImageJ with the Fiji plugin.
Convert the image to grayscale and 8-bit depth.
Draw a rectangle that exactly includes all the species in the first lane.
Go to “Analyze>Gels>Select First Lane” to set up the first rectangle.
Move the rectangle to the next lane.
Go to “Analyze>Gels>Select Next Lane” until all lanes are included.
Go to “Analyze>Gels>Plot Lanes” to generate a profile plot of each lane.
Choose the Straight Line selection tool and draw short lines at both sides of a peak manually to enclose the area below it.
Draw a line at the bottom of the peak if it appears to float above the baseline of the profile plot to remove background.
Choose the Wand tracing tool and click enclosed areas to measure peaks.
Copy the results to an Excel spreadsheet.
Calculate [product]/([cOA] + [product]) in each lane to evaluate the activity of SiRe_0244 from each fraction of the size exclusion chromatography.
